title: US Nationwide Emergency Alert System Test Interrupted TV and Radio for One Minute
excerpt: FEMA and the FCC ran a nationwide EAS test on November 17. It interrupted TV and radio for about a minute; phones did not receive an alert.

rank_math_description: FEMA and the FCC run a nationwide Emergency Alert System test on Nov. 17. Time, message, and why phones will not get an alert this time.
